user.title: Connect Salad Chopping
user.description:
Enter the value of the auth cookie from your signed-in Salad dashboard.

I built this integration in a few hours with AI as a hobby project. I plan to maintain it, but it is a low priority and comes with no guarantees. Use it at your own risk and keep your Salad credentials safe.

Subscribe to [my YouTube channel](https://www.youtube.com/c/miyconst) to see what I am working on.
